data.raw_text:
Traffic Advisory 🚧

A section of Spanish Town Road near the Sandy Gully Bridge will be closed nightly from 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m., December 16–18, to facilitate sewer line repairs.

Westbound traffic heading to Six Miles will be rerouted, and motorists are urged to proceed with caution and follow posted signs.
